extracted.name: Butter-Roasted Cauliflower
extracted.description: Chef John’s quick and easy recipe for butter-roasted cauliflower is an unusual and tremendously tasty way to enjoy cauliflower.
ingredient_lines: 1 head cauliflower, cut into large florets
2 tablespoons butter, melted, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone baking mat.
Spread cauliflower onto prepared baking sheet. Brush each piece of cauliflower with melted butter. Season with salt and black pepper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Flip cauliflower and continue roasting until tender and golden, about 10 minutes more.
